summary_en: Upper limit 12,600 shares (0.93% of S/O ex-treasury). Yen16,795,800 authorization. ToSTNeT-3 method. Execution window 2026-07-10 to 2026-08-10. Rationale: flexible capital allocation.
title_en: Notice of Resolution on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: FLOBAL Corporation's board resolved on 2026-07-10 to authorize acquisition of up to 12,600 treasury shares (0.93% of 1,359,840 shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum of ¥16,795,800. The acquisition will be executed via ToSTNeT-3 (off-exchange self-tender facility on Tokyo Pro Market) over the window 2026-07-10 to 2026-08-10. The stated rationale is to enable flexible capital allocation responsive to the operating environment. As of the resolution date, the company held 101,400 treasury shares against 1,359,840 shares outstanding ex-treasury.
